env_context_strategy.evidence_quote:
the multi-turn decision-
making process of the agent is like walking on the

over KG, i.e., extraction, semantic, and logic tools.
tool_count.note: 5 extraction + 5 logic (count, intersect, union, judge, end) + 2 semantic = 12; Sec. 4.3 also mentions get_candidate_entity, possibly 13.
